bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
base=c22ffc587781874ef463c2d912774376fb4e55a8
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf || exit 62
files='src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs'
mask=0
bit=1
for f in $files; do
 live="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 63
 prev="$(git -C "$src" show "$base:$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 64
 if test "$live" = "$prev"; then echo "BASE_MATCH_$bit=YES"; else echo "BASE_MATCH_$bit=NO";mask=$((mask+bit));fi
 bit=$((bit*2))
done
if test "$mask" -gt 0;then echo "VIDEO_COMPAT_DIFF_MASK=$mask";exit $((80+mask));fi
echo VIDEO_COMPAT_EXACT_BASE=PASS
